description: Renovate replaces Dependabot in this repo rather than sitting alongside it: both would raise PRs for the same pip and GitHub Actions updates.

Nothing here is hash-locked - requirements_test.txt carries no --hash lines - so Renovate can manage Python safely. That is the difference from the add-on repo, where the hash-locked lockfile keeps Python with Dependabot.
Dependabot security alerts are unaffected by removing dependabot.yml; that file controls version-update PRs only.

packageRules.description: One PR for all GitHub Actions. Carries the security label Dependabot applied to this ecosystem, since a stale action is a supply-chain concern rather than a feature gap.
One PR for the Python test/tooling dependencies.

homeassistant/shapely in requirements_test.txt declare the supported FLOOR (CLAUDE.md; validate.yml's Pytest (HA floor) job tests it), not 'whatever's current' - widen never raises the lower bound, only the upper bound for an out-of-range release (e.g. <2027 -> <2028 once HA 2027.1 ships). Without this, the default range strategy ratchets the lower bound up on every routine release and silently re-drifts the floor (see requirements_test.txt's history before this rule existed).
